title: Rendering-disagreement review spec
description: Spec for a human review of a multi-rendering disagreement: 3-5 tiny, independent, concrete probes answerable from basic math/logic against the Lean renderings. One wrong probe = the claim is wrong (blocked).

campaign.description: Slug of the rendering campaign (e.g. bgs-clause-b) that produced the disagreement

lens_a.description: Named lens of rendering A (e.g. structure-first)

lens_b.description: Named lens of rendering B (e.g. witness-predicate)

informal_claim.description: The informal step-0 claim the renderings both target

batch_narrative.description: Optional recap paragraph prepended to the checklist (Option 3)

key.description: Unique probe id within the spec (e.g. q1)

kind.description: Probe kind: quantifier / direction / bound / existence, or a campaign-specific kind

question.description: The tiny concrete yes/no-or-pick-one question the human answers

choices.description: Answer options (the expected value must be one of them)

expected.description: The machine-derived expected answer (from the Lean renderings, not the informal wish

hint.description: Plain-language hint / inline gloss for the probe

gloss.description: Optional inline gloss for a non-core term mentioned in the question
